title: Audit retention: role-aware filtered data dump
creator: Aisha Rahman
description: Provide a secure, role-aware bulk dump capability for audit logs from the Console that supports CSV, JSON, and NDJSON outputs while respecting RBAC v2 filters, retention policies, and SSO-backed admin permissions. The goal is to let enterprise admins and compliance teams extract query-scoped audit slices (time-window, actor, resource, action, outcome) for offline analysis and e-discovery without exposing redacted fields to users who lack privileges. Must handle multi-GB exports via cursored incremental downloads, enforce rate and size limits, and produce manifest metadata (query, applied filters, snapshot_time, schema_version).
acceptance_criteria: Admins with export permission can request a filtered dump from Console and receive a download link when ready
RBAC v2 filters are enforced server-side; results never include fields flagged as 'sensitive' unless requester has explicit allow-list role
Supports CSV, JSON, NDJSON formats; manifest with schema and applied filters included in export bundle
Large exports (>500MB) are produced as multipart blobs with cursored pagination and resumable downloads
All export requests are logged to an immutable audit stream (separate from the exported data) with requester identity from SSO/SAML
Exports respect tenant-level retention and cannot retrieve records older than retention cutoff unless super-admin override is used (and is itself audited)
implementation_notes: Server-side query engine will apply RBAC v2 masking rules before serialization
Use cursor-based incremental listing (time+id cursor) to avoid deep OFFSET scans on BigTable/ClickHouse
Export worker will stream directly to pre-signed object storage to minimize memory; manifest JSON recorded in metadata store
Encryption-in-transit and at-rest required; generated download links expire after configurable TTL
Rate limit export initiation per org and throttle per concurrent worker to preserve runtime throughput

2026-03-06 PM note (Maya): Add telemetry events for export_created, export_completed, export_failed with tokenized requester id for SSO traceability.
2026-03-09 Ops (Jared): Added quota to prevent noisy exports during peak inference traffic; default concurrent exports per org = 2, adjustable via plan tier.

tradeoffs_and_decisions: Decided against synchronous on-the-fly CSV generation for >100k rows to avoid blocking request threads; background worker + presigned link chosen
Chose cursor (time+id) approach over purely time-windowed pagination to ensure deterministic ordering during concurrent writes
Opted to implement NDJSON as default for JSON exports to simplify incremental parsing for downstream tooling
Will gate inclusion of 'request_payload' and 'response_content' fields behind a separate sensitive-data allow-list to reduce blast radius
qa_notes: Test with synthetic 50M-row dataset to validate cursor stability and worker memory bounds
Verify RBAC masking across combinations: org-admin, security-reader, billing-admin, auditor_role
Test resumable multipart downloads and resume after simulated network failure
Pen test for indirect disclosure via manifest metadata (avoid including raw user identifiers unless necessary)
